goal: Allow external applications using libbitcoinkernel to inspect block and header data concurrently
Remove the exclusive database lock that forces users to shut down Bitcoin Core to run indexers
reviewability: Author silent 84 days and reworking parallel reader access after converting to draft
agreement: Broad interest in removing the LevelDB dependency and enabling parallel indexing (josibake, theuni)
Verified by differential fuzzing for 5000 CPU hours without issues (marcofleon)
Unaddressed objection: LockDirectory succeeds without locking on re-lock and drops the lock (pzafonte)
Unaddressed objection: directory committing is a no-op on Windows risking corruption (stickies-v)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it allows external consumers to read block and header data while a node is running
Unblocks concurrent index building for downstream tools like Electrs and Esplora

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it replaces the block index storage engine, affecting node crash safety and startup migration
Directly impacts validation persistence, file locking, and data integrity under power loss
